title: "Week11Lab-Task3"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

tourism <- read_csv(
  "singapore_tourism_receipts.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

item_order <- c(
  "Sightseeing, Entertainment & Gaming",
  "Shopping",
  "Other Components",
  "Food & Beverage",
  "Accommodation"
)

tourism_plot <- tourism |>
  mutate(
    quarter = factor(
      quarter,
      levels = sort(unique(quarter))
    ),

    item = factor(
      item,
      levels = item_order
    ),

    # Convert million SGD to billion SGD
    value_billion = value / 1000,

    # Only label larger sections to prevent overcrowding
    value_label = if_else(
      value_billion >= 2.5,
      sprintf("%.3f", value_billion),
      NA_character_
    )
  )
quarter_totals <- tourism_plot |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  summarise(
    total_billion = sum(value_billion),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
events <- tibble(
  quarter_text = c(
    "2020-Q2",
    "2022-Q2"
  ),

  annotation_position = c(
    8.5,
    11.5
  ),

  event_label = c(
    "COVID-19 Circuit Breaker\nand border restrictions",
    "Singapore reopened borders\nunder the Vaccinated Travel Framework"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    quarter = factor(
      quarter_text,
      levels = levels(tourism_plot$quarter)
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    quarter_totals,
    by = "quarter"
  )

receipt_colours <- c(
  "Sightseeing, Entertainment & Gaming" = "#00496F",
  "Shopping"                             = "#0F85A0",
  "Other Components"                    = "#F0DA3E",
  "Food & Beverage"                     = "#ED8B00",
  "Accommodation"                       = "#DD4124"
)

font_used <- "serif"


tourism_receipts_plot <- ggplot(
  tourism_plot,
  aes(
    x = quarter,
    y = value_billion,
    fill = item
  )
) +

  # Stacked bars
  geom_col(
    width = 0.88,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +

  # Value labels
  geom_text(
    aes(label = value_label),
    position = position_stack(
      vjust = 0.5,
      reverse = TRUE
    ),
    family = font_used,
    size = 4.5,
    colour = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Arrows pointing from the event labels to the relevant bars
  geom_segment(
    data = events,
    aes(
      x = quarter,
      xend = quarter,
      y = annotation_position - 1.8,
      yend = total_billion + 0.25
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "#555555",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    arrow = grid::arrow(
      length = grid::unit(0.09, "inches"),
      type = "closed"
    )
  ) +

  # Event labels
  geom_label(
    data = events,
    aes(
      x = quarter,
      y = annotation_position,
      label = event_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    family = font_used,
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.9,
    fill = "#FDF6E3",
    colour = "#222222",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.12, "lines")
  ) +

  # Manual colours
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = receipt_colours,
    breaks = item_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # Amount scale
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 31.5),
    breaks = seq(0, 30, 10),
    minor_breaks = seq(5, 25, 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +

  # Turn vertical columns into horizontal bars
  coord_flip(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "Singapore 2019–2024 Quarterly Tourism Receipts By Major Components",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Amount (Billion SGD)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: singstat.gov.sg"
  ) +

  # Legend layout
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = FALSE
    )
  ) +

  # Overall theme
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11,
    base_family = font_used
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = font_used
    ),

    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#FDF6E3",
      colour = NA
    ),

    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "#E5E5E5",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.minor = element_line(
      colour = "#F1F1F1",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      margin = margin(r = 14)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 9.5,
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(t = 4)
    ),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10.5
    ),

    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.62, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.62, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.1, "cm"),

    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8,
      r = 10,
      b = 8,
      l = 10
    )
  )

tourism_receipts_plot

```

Tourism receipts fell sharply during the COVID-19 period, with the cumulative total reaching only S$4,188 billion in 2020-Q2, compared with S$27,689 billion in 2019-Q4. Recovery became clearer after Singapore reopened its borders, rising from S$4,574 billion in 2022-Q2 to S$14,178 billion in 2022-Q4. By 2024-Q4, total receipts reached S$29,781 billion, exceeding the 2019-Q4 level. Other Components was the largest category in 2024-Q4 at S$9,104 billion.
